title: Jonas Brothers to Perform at NFL Show in Australia
seoTitle: Jonas Brothers to Perform at NFL Show in Australia
subtitle: The trio will perform at the league's first regular-season game in the country
excerpt: The Jonas Brothers will perform at halftime of the Rams vs. 49ers game in Melbourne on September 11. The NFL confirmed the group as the main attraction.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Jonas Brothers, currently on their Burning Up Tour All Over Again, will be the halftime performers for the game between the Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers on September 11, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. The NFL confirmed the trio's participation but did not disclose payment details.

Who Will Perform at Halftime

The American football league confirmed Nick, Joe, and Kevin Jonas as the main halftime performers. The announcement did not mention salary or appearance fees. The group was presented by American Express as part of the NFL's entertainment lineup.

How NFL Show Payments Work

In 2016, an NFL spokesperson stated that the league does not pay artists a conventional fee, only covering expenses and production costs. Recent reports indicate that artists receive payment based on a union scale, similar to those under the SAG-AFTRA agreement. For the Super Bowl, the average is about US$1,000 per day, but this amount does not directly apply to the Jonas Brothers' case.

What the NFL Covers

In addition to union scale payment, the NFL covers travel expenses, production, and other costs related to the performance. While there's no confirmation of cash payment, the group receives cost coverage and exposure.

Exposure and Promotion for the Trio

The show takes place during the first regular NFL game in Australia, offering the trio significant visibility before an international sports audience. The performance aligns with the Burning Up Tour All Over Again schedule, which runs from August to December, creating an additional platform for promoting their music and live shows.

The Melbourne Event

The game between the Rams and 49ers will be held at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, marking the NFL's first regular-season game in the country. The league describes the matchup as an international milestone, with the Jonas Brothers at the center of the entertainment program.

With information from Bolavip US.
